title: File paths and text encoding

spans.text: Build platform-independent paths with pathlib. Setting encoding='utf-8' when opening text files makes encoding behavior explicit.

spans.code:
from pathlib import Path

path = Path('data') / 'notes.txt'
path.write_text('Salam', encoding='utf-8')
No console output; creates data/notes.txt containing Salam.

spans.text: pathlib.Path composes paths for the current platform.

spans.title: Important tip
spans.text: Use a with block so the file is closed reliably.

visual_description: A separate visual is not essential; a small runnable code example and its expected output explain the topic.
